faces.transcription: Destroy the objective "Disrupt the First Trial." Find card 85 in the Operations deck. Use this objective as your second objective for the second half of February.
faces.flavor: "I know it ain't easy, but we're gonna send you out again. The trials are already done with, but maybe you can quietly, and I do mean quietly, quarantine some of the population to slow down the spread of this thing."
